case.name: tipo_cuenta_no_permitido
case.description: Account type PRE is not in CTE/AHO/VIR: rejected with 50001 before any table is read.

case.name: orden_no_existe
case.description: No order row for the number and company: error 50002.

case.name: orden_no_pendiente
case.description: Order exists with status C (not pending): error 50003.

case.name: pago_web_tarifa_empresa_comision_incluida
case.description: Happy path: company tariff 2.00 with separada N, WEB channel gives commission 1.00 and a total of 101.00 debited in one movement. The order moves to A.

case.name: tarifa_servicio_por_defecto_canal_ventanilla
case.description: No company tariff: the service default 1.50 applies with separada N. A non-WEB channel pays the full tariff, so total is 101.50.

case.name: tarifa_nula_se_toma_como_cero
case.description: No company tariff and srv_tarifa NULL: the tariff becomes 0, commission 0, total 100.00.

case.name: web_redondeo_media_tarifa
case.description: WEB channel with tariff 1.25: half is 0.625, rounded to 2 decimals.

case.name: nomina_exenta_de_comision
case.description: Service NOMINA on the WEB channel with tariff 1.25: commission forced to 0, total 100.00.

case.name: comision_separada_segundo_debito
case.description: Company tariff 2.00 with separada S on a non-WEB channel: the payment debits 100.00 and the commission 2.00 is debited as a second movement.

case.name: comision_separada_en_cero_sin_segundo_debito
case.description: separada S but commission is 0 (NOMINA): only one debit is made, the commission debit is skipped.

case.name: comision_separada_falla_deshace_pago
case.description: separada S: the payment debit succeeds but the commission debit returns non-zero. The transaction is rolled back (the first debit is undone) and error 50006 is raised.

case.name: debito_falla
case.description: sp_debito returns non-zero on the payment debit: rollback and error 50005.

case.name: vir_saldo_insuficiente
case.description: VIR account, balance 50.00 and total 60.00: no overdraft margin for VIR, so error 50004.

case.name: vir_saldo_exacto_pasa
case.description: VIR account with balance exactly equal to the total (60.00): the funds check passes and the payment completes.

case.name: aho_limite_sobregiro_pasa
case.description: AHO account with balance -40.00 and total 60.00: -40 + 100 = 60 is not less than 60, so the check passes (upper edge of the overdraft margin).

case.name: cte_bajo_limite_sobregiro
case.description: CTE account with balance -40.01 and total 60.00: -40.01 + 100 < 60, so error 50004 (just beyond the margin).

case.name: cuenta_inexistente_saldo_nulo
case.description: The account row does not exist, so the balance stays NULL and the funds check does not reject. The legacy decides what happens (the payment goes on to the debit).

quirks.behavior: `select @v = col from t where ...` leaves @v unchanged when no row matches and keeps the LAST row when several match; it never fails.
quirks.target: Keep the previous value when the query returns nothing and take the last row when it returns several; do not throw on an empty or multiple result.
quirks.probe:
declare @v int
select @v = 5
select @v = id from sysobjects where 1 = 2
select 'NXQ|select-assign-from-table|' + convert(varchar(10), @v)

quirks.behavior: A failing statement does not stop the procedure: execution goes on and the program decides with @@error and @@rowcount, which every statement resets.
quirks.target: Read the outcome of each statement right after it (rows affected, error) and continue as the program does; do not let an exception skip the code the legacy runs after the error.

quirks.behavior: Transactions nest by count (@@trancount); a ROLLBACK at any level rolls back everything and sets the count to 0.
quirks.target: Use one transaction for the whole program and roll it back entirely where the program rolls back.
quirks.probe:
begin tran
begin tran
rollback tran
select 'NXQ|nested-tran|' + convert(varchar(10), @@trancount)

quirks.behavior: Comparisons ignore trailing spaces ('a' = 'a  ') and CHAR(n) values are padded with spaces to n.
quirks.target: Compare strings without their trailing spaces and pad or trim CHAR values as the golden master shows.
